archetypes.name: bash-flow
archetypes.rationale: The diff changes stateful shell orchestration across /design Gate B, assessor, revert, and validator paths.
archetypes.prompt_body: Investigate the shell control flow around Step 3.5 auto-apply, Step 3.6 assessor handling, and transitions back to Step 3b. Look for inconsistent exit-code handling, missing completion sentinels, stale state after revert, or branches that can skip required cleanup. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
